checks.reproduction: For an onsite evacuation cursor, calculation-current + evacuation-task + response-phase + channel-free + !all-evacuated selects onsite-evac; replacing the last fact with all-evacuated selects priority-0 onsite-resolved. Controller has no parallel result branch and commits only the returned graph decision.

A result with a different run/generation or in-flight request is discarded before ResultReceived. An ACK with another job requestId/lastControlRequestId, or an evacuation ACK with the wrong release revision, is not stored in operationAcks; the graph therefore cannot receive own-*-ack=TRUE for that operation.

Make EnqueueOperation or return eligibility fail after Evaluate. ObserveAcceptedResult marks the operation unavailable and exits, while ApplyUserProgression returns rejection; neither path calls Commit after the failed effect, so node/revision/taken-edge do not record success.

At onsite or standby with medical-task=TRUE and all-evacuated=TRUE, evacuation-task remains FALSE, so resolved evacuation edges cannot fire. The medical path requires its own ACK, reaches medical-confirmation, and only manual-confirm selects return.

Pause prevents new Tick processing; a new run clears task queues, missions, graph cursors, traces, evidence keys and sequence. Missing facts evaluate UNKNOWN and never enable/select an edge because execution requires TRUE. Snapshot Recent is emitted oldest-to-newest for the selected operation; the view scans it backward and displays the newest matching record.

scopeBoundary: Read-only source review only. No Unity/native execution or broad test run; scene binding, compilation, and live branch traversal remain root-owned acceptance evidence.
